name: policy-system
description: Ask compliance questions against the Policy System knowledge graph (ps-qna skill) via PS Service's remote MCP connector.

ps_service_url.title: PS Service MCP endpoint URL
ps_service_url.description: Full URL to PS Service's MCP endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8000/mcp for a local-test deployment, or https://<host>/mcp for a remote one.

operator_token.title: Operator credential (optional)
operator_token.description: Individual-operator bearer credential for PS Service. Leave blank for a local-test deployment running under PS_SERVICE_LOCAL_TEST_BYPASS=true — PS Service does not yet validate per-user credentials (tracked on issue #39 Group 3 / #58, not #65, which is only the now-deprioritized credential-flow spike). This field exists so the connector is ready to forward one the moment server-side validation lands, without a plugin update.
